citations.assessment: The Yerushalmi attests Hosheaiah son of Rabbi Shami, including his correspondence with Mana, and a separate reading Yehoshaya son of Rabbi Shammai in Ketubot. Keep Heilprin’s transmitted spelling and patronymic without inferring any further identification.
